An identification-link antenna for the Promin. Establishes the link between the worn scanner and the Promin's processor. Install into the Promin.
 
%c[255,235,205,110]FEATURES:
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Links the scanner to the Promin
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Required for the identification kit

Processes scan data from the identification scanner. Install into the Promin -- one process module at a time.
 
%c[255,235,205,110]FEATURES:
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Base scan time ~1.5 s
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Reveals faction
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Reveals distance
